notes.title: Regarding the development progress of the next work
notes.content: [p]The next work is titled 'Chinese Style Community' and is currently being produced intensively.[/p][p]At present, all character portraits have been completed, and the script has also been fully written,[/p][p]The game content is quite explosive, and it is a familiar and unfamiliar "community" for most people, with very Chinese characteristics.[/p][p]There are multiple female characters with different styles appearing, and the overall story flow has been optimized compared to the previous work.[/p][p]This is a true Galgame with Chinese characteristics,[/p][p]At present, there should not be any domestic Galgame with this theme,[/p][p]Because those developers with petty bourgeois tendencies cannot write realistic and beautiful plots, they can only write things that disgust players.[/p][p]Good works are always born in pain, and pain and suffering are the source of inspiration,[/p][p]But it cannot be just suffering, let alone they have never experienced true suffering. Art originates from life and is higher than life.[/p][p]This may be the author's last Galgame, and the author himself will do his best to produce it,[/p][p]Bringing players truly excellent Galgame with Chinese characteristics[/p]

notes.title: Some content of the lower work
notes.content: The characters in this fantasy film will make guest appearances in the next installment. Stay tuned.

notes.title: The ongoing development plan
notes.content: The next Galgame is currently in production, sharing the same worldview as this work, but its quality is definitely far superior to this one, and it will reveal the true ending and the fate of some characters. Stay tuned.
